Same format as [Data Safari #1](week04-data-safari.qmd) — find a paper, recreate a figure from its public data, and reflect on the process. Render this file to PDF and submit both the `.qmd` and the rendered `.pdf` via Canvas alongside this week's regular assignment, before Week 11's lecture (Monday). See the [syllabus](../syllabus.qmd#assignments) for the late policy.

**Tip:** with regression and ANCOVA under your belt, look for a figure showing a **relationship between two continuous variables**, ideally with multiple groups shown by color and a fitted trend line per group — the kind of figure an ANCOVA model would produce.
